pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown polygonal regions with high-frequency, jagged edge serration (crenulated margins). The pixel gradients at patch borders are sharp, showing minimal transition between dark and light values.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored interstitial pathways. Intersections primarily consist of three-way and four-way junction nodes. Pixel thickness is narrow and relatively uniform across the visible flank and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense mane visible along the dorsal neck with a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background vegetation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, elongated vertical dark anomaly (likely a scar or lesion) is visible on the neck-shoulder junction, disrupting the local patch geometry.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian subject (oxpecker) perched on the upper dorsal ridge near the shoulder region.
